title: feat(spec)!: refuse at save a system hook or script action body that writes an identity-assignment object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBRDFqiYQLscu1ybuLZGACQn)_
Fixes #25653

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`HookSchema` 与 `ActionSchema` 在保存时拒收「以 system 提权运行、且沙箱 JS 正文写四个身份分配对象(岗位持有、权限集授予、邀请、成员)」的钩子/动作;`Hook.runAs` 说明补上「提权不触及身份分配」;新增一条 ADR-0087 D3 条目。
- 为什么改:运行时早已拒绝这类写入(上两片已合入),但保存门仍然接受,作者只能在运行失败时才发现;裁决 6384657105 字母 A 要求整个家族在保存时同样拒收。
- 风险与回滚:只收窄 spec 的接受集,运行时不变;仓内普查为零命中,不会有已发布的钩子或动作开始被拒;回滚即撤回本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/identity/identity-assignment-body-writes.ts`(判定与拒收文案)、`packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts` 的 `refuseElevatedIdentityAssignmentBodyWrite`、`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` 的 `refuseIdentityAssignmentBodyWrite`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/identity/identity-assignment-body-writes.test.ts`,预期 28 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

App-authored automation does not use elevation to write `sys_user_position`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_invitation` or `sys_member` (ruling record 6384657105, letter A). The run-time half landed in #25954 and #25982: the data middleware refuses that write with `PERMISSION_DENIED`. This PR is the save-time half that triage routed to `domain:spec` (6431012701).

- **New leaf `packages/spec/src/identity/identity-assignment-body-writes.ts`** (import-free, not exported from the barrel). It holds the four-object set, the reading of a sandboxed body's source (a write method `insert`, `update`, `delete`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany` or `upsert` on `ctx.api.object('OBJECT')`, called on the handle or on a name the body bound it to), and the refusal text with its prescription per source.
- **`HookSchema`** gains a second object-level check, `refuseElevatedIdentityAssignmentBodyWrite`. It refuses a hook that declares `runAs: 'system'` and carries a `language: 'js'` body whose source writes one of the four objects. There is one `custom` issue per object, at `body.source`. The JSON-stage hook in `stack.zod.ts` keeps the check through `safeExtend`.
- **`ActionSchema`** gains `refuseIdentityAssignmentBodyWrite`: the same check for a `type: 'script'` action, whose body always runs as system.
- **`Hook.runAs`**: the JSDoc and the `.describe()` now say that elevation does not reach identity assignment, as `FlowSchema.runAs` does. The hook reference page was regenerated (`gen:docs`).
- **ADR-0087 D3 entry** `hook-action-body-system-identity-assignment-write-refused` sits beside `18.flow-run-as-system-identity-assignment-write-refused`. It adds no tombstone and no D2 conversion.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING, `adr-0087: registered`.

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/identity/identity-assignment-body-writes.test.ts`, 28 cases:
- The reader names each of the four objects for every write method and every quote form. It also names a write on a bound handle, and each object once.
- `HookSchema`, the registered `hook` type schema, `ActionSchema` and the registered `action` type schema each refuse each object at `body.source`, with the right prescription.
- `defineStack` refuses with `422 STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` at `hooks.N.body.source`. It refuses the action too. An artifact's parse refuses the hook.
- The D3 entry is registered at 18 with no conversion and no tombstone.
- Controls (what the run-time refusal leaves legal too): reads of the four objects, writes to other objects, a hook under `runAs: 'user'`, an expression body and a code handler.

## Acceptance notes

- Census at `origin/main` `e931621a`: no hook or action body in this repository calls `ctx.api.object(...)` on one of the four objects (`git grep`, 0 hits; the control pattern over every `sys_*` object hits 6 files). So no shipped body starts being refused. hotcrm was not re-measured from this session. The run-time slices' census found none there.
- The four-object set and the prescription text now live in two places: this spec leaf and plugin-security's `FLOW_SYSTEM_IDENTITY_WRITE_OBJECTS`. The claim's file surface is spec-only, so plugin-security does not import the spec set yet. That would also make the leaf a public export.
- `FlowSchema` has no save-time twin of this check. A `runAs: 'system'` flow's write node aimed at one of the four objects is refused only at run time, by the earlier change. This is noted here, not filed.

## Verification

All readings below are at head `1234236ab` unless noted.

<details><summary>Spec package</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` under `os-verify-lock`: VERDICT command-exit 0 · Test Files 728 passed (728) · Tests 22037 passed | 1 todo. The pre-merge head `2a0debc6` read 727 files / 22012 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` OK).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 5 changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date after the merge of `origin/main`. The only regenerated artifact is `content/docs/references/data/hook.mdx`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one behaviour: the body-source reader)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `return [...named];` with `return [];` in the leaf. The anchor went 1 → 0 and the blob changed. With the mutation, the test file read 20 failed | 8 passed. The 20 were exactly the refusal rows. The 8 that stayed green were the 6 controls and the 2 ledger pins. On restore, the blob equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The spec suite imports from `src/`, so no rebuild was involved.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head `1234236ab`: 114 families. All 114 exited 0 on the first pass.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` with every exit code recorded: 114 derived, 114 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- On the pre-merge head `2a0debc6` the same derivation (114 families, two different) also ended 114/114 exit 0. Eight of them first answered exit 3 (a prerequisite: an unbuilt workspace or the shallow clone), and they exited 0 after a full build and fetching the pinned fixture commit.
- `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` (a local-only family): exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood (full battery, final head)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock` at `1234236ab`, after a full workspace build (118/118): VERDICT command-exit 1 · Test Files 2 failed | 298 passed | 3 skipped (303) · Tests 10 failed | 2522 passed | 18 skipped (2550).

The 10 failures are all in `test/authz-conformance.test.ts` (the #17111 docblock-figure pins: "docblock says 80 rows, the table holds 81" for `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`) and `test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` (the `this.routeManager.register(` control in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` reads 63, pinned at 62). They are not caused by this diff. It touches no file under `packages/rest` or `packages/qa`: `git diff e677770ae 1234236ab -- packages/rest packages/qa` is empty. The row came from `6a2866af7` (#26361), which is already an ancestor of this branch's base `e931621a` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0). So `main`'s own full battery carries the same reds.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint on the changed files locally; the repo-wide run is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
